_provenance: Schema-derived fixture — Cycle B2 RED. Represents the shape of an Alpaca Markets v2 bars API response for daily bars. Written before any implementation (TDD RED phase). Values are type/format sentinels — NOT hardcoded producer outputs (feedback_no_hardcoded_test_values). The technicals producer (advisors/lens_technicals.py) consumes bars in this shape via synthetic_history.fetch_bars.
_field_reference: Alpaca Markets v2 bars API — https://docs.alpaca.markets/reference/stockbars. Each bar: t (RFC3339 timestamp), o (open float), h (high float), l (low float), c (close float), v (volume int), vw (VWAP float), n (trade count int).

invariants.timestamp_format: t is an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 string; t[:10] gives YYYY-MM-DD
invariants.ordering: bars are ordered chronologically (oldest first) within a symbol
invariants.minimum_bars_for_50sma: at least 50 bars required; fewer → 50-day SMA unavailable
invariants.minimum_bars_for_200sma: at least 200 bars required; fewer → 200-day SMA unavailable
invariants.minimum_bars_for_momentum: at least 21 bars required for 20-day return (current + 20 prior closes)
